advisories.distro_note: Distribution packages may backport the fix without changing the upstream version string — verify via the package changelog or distro advisory, not the version alone. Third-party repositories lagged the fix on release day (Remi had no fixed build on 2026-10-21): when the repo has no fixed package, use the official container image or a source build, or apply the interim mitigations.
advisories.eol_note: Branches below 8.2 receive no security fixes from the PHP project. There is NO patched release for them: the only remedies are a branch upgrade or taking the site offline (CERT-EU).
interim_mitigations: Restrict access to the site (IP allow-list at the proxy / CDN) until patched — reduces exposure; it is not a fix
Enforce request-size limits at the reverse proxy / CDN edge as defense-in-depth
If no patched release can be deployed, take the site offline (CERT-EU guidance for unpatchable sites)
advisories.summary: Two critical flaws in PHP core: CVE-2026-109618 (remote code execution via out-of-memory corruption) and CVE-2026-109619 (remote code execution via stale global state). Both are exploitable over the network with no authentication. Any PHP application on a vulnerable build is exposed, regardless of the application itself.
advisories.timeline: Vulnerability details leaked 2026-10-20. Fixed releases published 2026-10-21 (14:00 UTC). Exploitation was observed in the wild from 2026-10-21 07:43 UTC (Cloudflare data, reported by Sansec) — the exposure window opens at the leak, not at the patch.
advisories.title: php2shell — unauthenticated remote code execution in PHP core

source_notes: Fixed releases published by the PHP project on 2026-10-21 (~14:00 UTC). CERT-EU advisory 2026-018, a CISA alert and an FBI alert circulated the same day; CERT-EU advised operators who cannot patch to take affected sites offline.
